game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Wolf Watch, a lookout against wolves: the snow ranger must handle icicle bats while practicing functions. Core idea – Library Builder: Combine small functions into a reusable library the snow ranger calls throughout the level.
theme: Snowy Hold – Wolf Watch: a lookout against wolves
core_gameplay_loop: In Wolf Watch, repeat each round: Combine small functions into a reusable library the snow ranger calls throughout the level. Each round, icicle bats strike the watch bell, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the library value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the watch bell from icicle bats in Wolf Watch: keep the library meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 54-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: library drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 54-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Library Builder
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Library Builder' (Week 6 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Wolf Watch'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how library changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against icicle bats in Wolf Watch.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 54 seconds while library > 0.
